gift.label: the gift {actor} gave {whom}
gift.say: {Actor} once gave me a gift. I remember it.

alms.label: the alms {actor} gave {whom}
alms.say: {Actor} gave me coin when I had none. I've not forgotten.
alms.sayKin: {Actor} gave my {vr} {vn} coin when there was none in the house.

healed.label: the healing {actor} brought {whom}
healed.say: {Actor} saw me through a sickness. I owe you my life.
healed.sayKin: {Actor} nursed my {vr} {vn} back from the fever.

burial.label: the burial {actor} gave {whom}
burial.say: {Actor} saw to a burial for me.
burial.sayKin: {Actor} paid for my {vr} {vn}'s burial. We have not forgotten it.

hired.label: the work {actor} gave {whom}
hired.say: {Actor} gave me honest work when I needed it.
hired.sayKin: {Actor} gave my {vr} {vn} work when work was scarce.

wages_unpaid.label: the wages {actor} never paid {whom}
wages_unpaid.say: {Actor} never paid me what I was owed.
wages_unpaid.sayKin: {Actor} never paid my {vr} {vn} what was owed.

wed.label: the marriage {actor} made with {whom}
wed.sayKin: {Actor} wed my {vr} {vn}. We are kin now, you and I.

assaulted.label: the beating {actor} gave {whom}
assaulted.say: {Actor} beat me in the street. My bones still ache of it.

murdered.label: the killing of {whom} by {actor}
murdered.sayKin: {Actor} killed my {vr} {vn}. I will not forget it while I live.

robbed.label: the theft {actor} made from {whom}
robbed.say: {Actor} stole from my house. I saw it with my own eyes.

well_poisoned.label: the well {actor} poisoned, and {whom} who drank of it
well_poisoned.say: {Actor} poisoned our well. I drank of it and lived.
well_poisoned.sayKin: {Actor} poisoned the well, and my {vr} {vn} drank of it.
well_poisoned.sayTown: {Actor} poisoned the well of this town. The children drank first.

granary_burnt.label: the granary {actor} burnt
granary_burnt.say: {Actor} burnt our granary in the lean months.
granary_burnt.sayKin: {Actor} burnt the bread out of my {vr} {vn}'s mouth.
granary_burnt.sayTown: {Actor} burnt this town's granary in the lean months. We ate bark that spring.

grain_hoarded.label: the grain {actor} hoarded while {whom} went hungry
grain_hoarded.say: {Actor} sat on a loft of grain while we starved, and sold it back to us dear.
grain_hoarded.sayKin: {Actor} hoarded grain while my {vr} {vn} went hungry.
grain_hoarded.sayTown: {Actor} sat on a loft of grain here in the hungry years and sold it back to us at a famine price.

plague_lie.label: the plague lie {actor} told of this town
plague_lie.say: {Actor} cried plague on us for profit. The carters stayed away a month.
plague_lie.sayTown: {Actor} cried plague on this town for profit, and the carters stayed away.

grave_robbed.label: the grave of {whom} that {actor} dug open
grave_robbed.sayKin: {Actor} dug up my {vr} {vn}'s grave for the goods in it.

hanged.label: the hanging of {whom} by order of {actor}
hanged.sayTown: {Actor} hanged {vn} in this town. The square remembers it.

ruled_merciful.label: the mercy {actor} showed at court
ruled_merciful.sayTown: {Actor} showed mercy at court here, when {vn} stood before you. Folk remember.

ruled_harsh.label: the harsh judgement {actor} gave
ruled_harsh.sayTown: {Actor} was hard on {vn} at court. Folk here remember it.

ruled_generous.label: the open hand {actor} showed at court
ruled_generous.sayTown: {Actor} was open-handed at court here. It is still spoken of.

ruled_unjust.label: the unjust ruling {actor} gave
ruled_unjust.sayTown: {Actor} judged {vn} unjustly here. Folk have long memories.

dole.label: the grain {actor} gave in the famine
dole.sayTown: {Actor} fed this town in the famine. We remember who kept us alive.

raided.label: the raid {actor} made on the town
raided.sayTown: {Actor} put this town to the torch. The scorch marks are on the old houses still.

conquered.label: the taking of the town by {actor}
conquered.sayTown: {Actor} took this town by the sword.

defended.label: the defence {actor} made of the town
defended.sayTown: {Actor} held this town against its enemies.

amends.label: the amends {actor} made to {whom}
amends.say: {Actor} came and made amends. It does not undo it, but it was done.
amends.sayTown: {Actor} paid to rebuild what was lost here. Folk remember that too.

spurned.label: the amends {actor} never made to {whom}
spurned.say: {Actor} knew what was owed and never came.
spurned.sayKin: {Actor} never came to make it right for my {vr} {vn}.
spurned.sayTown: {Actor} never came to make it right with this town.

threatened.label: the threats {actor} made to {whom}
threatened.say: {Actor} came to my door with threats instead of an apology.
threatened.sayKin: {Actor} threatened my {vr} {vn} instead of making it right.

kept_faith.label: the old friendship {actor} kept with {whom}
kept_faith.say: {Actor} remembered what was between our families, and came when we asked.
kept_faith.sayKin: {Actor} came when my {vr} {vn} called on the old friendship.

abandoned.label: the help {actor} never sent {whom}
abandoned.say: {Actor} let us down when we called on the old friendship.
abandoned.sayKin: {Actor} left my {vr} {vn} to it when we called for help.

protected.label: the protection {actor} gave {whom}
protected.say: {Actor} stood at my door when they came for me.
protected.sayKin: {Actor} stood by my {vr} {vn} when they came for us.

promise_kept.label: the promise {actor} kept to {whom}
promise_kept.say: {Actor} gave me their word, and kept it.

promise_broken.label: the promise {actor} broke to {whom}
promise_broken.say: {Actor} gave me their word and broke it.

spoke_ill.label: the ill word {whom} had of {actor}
spoke_ill.sayKin: My {vr} {vn} has nothing good to say of {actor}.

slandered.label: the talk {actor} spread about {whom}
slandered.say: {Actor} has been spreading talk about me. It got back to me.

praised.label: the good word {actor} put about for {whom}
praised.say: {Actor} has been saying good things of me about town.
praised.sayKin: {Actor} spoke up for my {vr} {vn} about town.

lost_with.label: the road {whom} took with {actor} and never came home from
lost_with.say: I took the road with {actor}, once.
lost_with.sayKin: My {vr} {vn} left with {actor} and never came home.

vanished_with.label: what became of {whom} on the road with {actor}
vanished_with.say: I took the road with {actor}, once.
vanished_with.sayKin: My {vr} {vn} left with {actor} and never came home. I would like to know why.
vanished_with.sayTown: {vn} left this town with {actor} and never came back. Folk here have not forgotten.

foul_play.label: what {actor} did to {whom} on the road
foul_play.say: I took the road with {actor}, once.
foul_play.sayKin: My {vr} {vn} left with {actor} and never came home. I know what you are.
foul_play.sayTown: {vn} left this town with {actor} and was never seen again. Folk here say it was no accident.

witch_burned.label: the burning of {whom} as a witch on {actor}'s word
witch_burned.sayKin: {Actor} cried witch on my {vr} {vn}, and they burned her for it. She healed half this town.
witch_burned.sayTown: {Actor} cried witch on {vn}, and this town burned her for it. Some say it was for her land.

witch_accused.label: the witchcraft {actor} laid on {whom}
witch_accused.say: {Actor} called me a witch before the whole town.
witch_accused.sayKin: {Actor} called my {vr} {vn} a witch, to get at what was hers.
witch_accused.sayTown: {Actor} cried witch on {vn} here, and the priest would not have it.

crypt_profaned.label: the crypt {actor} broke open
crypt_profaned.sayTown: {Actor} broke open the crypt of {vn} here and scattered the dead. The priest still says the prayers over it.

no_word.label: the word {actor} never brought of {whom}
no_word.sayKin: {Actor} never came to tell us what became of my {vr} {vn}.

brought_word.label: the word {actor} brought of {whom}
brought_word.sayKin: {Actor} came to our door to tell us how my {vr} {vn} died. That was decent.

false_accused.label: the theft {actor} swore against {whom}
false_accused.say: {Actor} swore to the watch that I was a thief. I never was.
false_accused.sayKin: {Actor} swore to the watch that my {vr} {vn} was a thief.
false_accused.sayTown: {Actor} swore {vn} was a thief, and the court would not have it.

framed.label: the goods {actor} planted on {whom}
framed.say: {Actor} put stolen goods in my house and sent the watch to find them.
framed.sayKin: {Actor} planted stolen goods on my {vr} {vn}, and swore them to the gallows.
framed.sayTown: {Actor} hid stolen goods in {vn}'s house and sent the watch. This town hanged an innocent for it.

sold_bondage.label: the selling of {whom} to the galleys by {actor}
sold_bondage.say: {Actor} sold me to the galley masters. Years at the oar. I came home to find you still here.
sold_bondage.sayKin: {Actor} sold my {vr} {vn} to the galleys like a beast.
sold_bondage.sayTown: {Actor} sold {vn} of this town to the slavers at the harbour. No one here forgets it.

held_captive.label: the cellar {actor} kept {whom} in
held_captive.say: {Actor} kept me chained in a cellar.
held_captive.sayKin: {Actor} kept my {vr} {vn} chained in a cellar like a dog.
held_captive.sayTown: {Actor} kept {vn} chained in a cellar in this town.

starved.label: the starving of {whom} in {actor}'s cellar
starved.say: {Actor} left me to starve in the dark.
starved.sayKin: {Actor} starved my {vr} {vn} to death in a cellar.
starved.sayTown: {Actor} let {vn} starve to death in a cellar here. They found the bones.

stocked.label: the stocks {actor} put {whom} in for a debt
stocked.say: {Actor} put me in the stocks for a debt, for the whole town to pelt.
stocked.sayKin: {Actor} put my {vr} {vn} in the stocks over a few coins of rent.
stocked.sayTown: {Actor} put {vn} in the stocks in the square over the rent. Folk here remember a hard landlord.

stocks_died.label: the death of {whom} in {actor}'s stocks
stocks_died.sayKin: My {vr} {vn} died in the stocks where {actor} put them, over the rent.
stocks_died.sayTown: {vn} died in the stocks in the square, put there by {actor} over the rent.

evicted_winter.label: the snow {actor} turned {whom} out into
evicted_winter.say: {Actor} turned me out of my house in the dead of winter.
evicted_winter.sayKin: {Actor} put my {vr} {vn} out in the snow in the dead of winter.
evicted_winter.sayTown: {Actor} turned a family out into the snow here, in the dead of winter.

froze_evicted.label: the winter {whom} froze in after {actor} put them out
froze_evicted.sayKin: My {vr} {vn} froze to death after {actor} turned us out in the winter.
froze_evicted.sayTown: {vn} froze in the lanes after {actor} put the family out. That winter is still spoken of.

branded.label: the brand {actor} burned on {whom}
branded.say: {Actor} burned a thief's brand on me with their own hand. I wear it still.
branded.sayKin: {Actor} burned a brand on my {vr} {vn}, and no court said they should.
branded.sayTown: {Actor} branded {vn} in the street, with no court and no judge.

maimed.label: the hand {actor} took from {whom}
maimed.say: {Actor} took my hand for a theft. Look at it.
maimed.sayKin: {Actor} took my {vr} {vn}'s hand in the street, with no court and no judge.
maimed.sayTown: {Actor} cut off {vn}'s hand in the street. No judge, no court.

rough_justice.label: the justice {actor} did on a thief
rough_justice.sayTown: {Actor} caught {vn} thieving and marked them as our fathers did. The thieves keep away.

storyLeads.2: It is a story in my family, from my {from}'s day.
storyLeads.older: My family has told it for generations.

refuseTrade: I'll not trade with your House. Not after {label}.
